item.title: UBTECH Details Thinker-WM, a World Model That Unifies Video, Depth and Robot Actions
item.description: UBTECH says Thinker-WM tops three embodied world model benchmarks. Adding depth lifted single-task success on RoboTwin by 15 percentage points in its ablation tests.

item.title: Rokid and Tencent Mobility Bring Voice Ride-Hailing to AI Glasses via Agent-to-Agent Link
item.description: Users say a destination and the glasses handle pickup points, fare comparison, booking and password-free payment, with car details shown in view while they wait.

item.description: The Windows and macOS app lets users draw paths, arrange timelines, sync motion to music and monitor a fleet of humanoids, with a one-tap emergency stop.

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources Hy Memory 2.0, Adding Working and Code Memory for AI Agents

item.description: The new endpoints return structured web results or a page as Markdown. Each costs 5 yuan per 1,000 successful requests and is capped at 5 queries per second per account.
